article.name: Lionel Messi leaves FC Barcelona
article.body: Lionel Messi wept on Sunday as he bade farewell to his boyhood team FC Barcelona and confirmed he was talking with French club Paris St Germain over a possible move.

article.name: Amazon to pay shoppers hurt by others' products, does not admit liability
article.body: Amazon.com Inc (AMZN.O) on Tuesday said it would pay customers who suffer injuries or property damage from defective goods others sell on its U.S. platform, in a new policy that could reduce litigation.
